quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #12
										  					
  

35 Questions • Passing Score 28

questions.question: You can use a cellphone while driving if you use a hands-free device and are over 18 years old.
questions.explanation: Illinois law says you cannot use a handheld cellphone or text while driving. You can use hands-free devices or Bluetooth if you are 19 years old or older.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about conditions just ahead. This sign warns you of a steep hill. Slow down and shift to a lower gear to control your speed and protect your brakes.

questions.question: Traffic is merging into your freeway lane. What should you do?

options.text: Make room for the merging traffic, if possible.
Drive faster to keep your right-of-way.

questions.correctAnswerText: Make room for the merging traffic, if possible.
questions.explanation: When you can, make room in your lane to let other vehicles merge safely.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn. You may see this sign at intersections where oncoming traffic is a concern.

questions.question: Looking far ahead on the highway helps you:
questions.explanation: Watch the road far ahead. This helps you stop or change lanes with time to spare. You will drive safer, use less fuel, and help traffic flow smoothly.

questions.question: When a train is coming, how far from the railroad track must all vehicles stop?
questions.explanation: Stop 15 to 50 feet from the nearest track if you see a stop sign, flashing lights, lowered gates, a flagger's signal, or an approaching train.

questions.question: When you pass another vehicle, you should:

options.text: Drive at the same speed as the other vehicle.
Pass as safely and as quickly as possible.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pass as safely and as quickly as possible.
questions.explanation: Pass quickly and safely. Move back to your lane only when you can see both headlights of the passed vehicle in your mirror.

questions.question: On a freeway, look farther ahead than you would on a city street:

options.text: Because it takes a quarter mile to stop.

questions.explanation: Watch for changes in traffic, signals from other drivers, merging vehicles at on-ramps, and sudden road or traffic changes.

questions.question: Drivers must yield to disabled pedestrians using a guide dog, white cane, or other assistive device.
questions.explanation: A pedestrian with a disability using a guide dog, white cane, wheelchair, or other assistive device has the right-of-way, whether on a sidewalk or road.

questions.question: If you become tired while driving, you should:

options.text: Stop to rest or change drivers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop to rest or change drivers.
questions.explanation: Stop and rest or let someone else drive. Tiredness slows your thinking and reactions, making driving unsafe.

questions.question: Your license can be suspended if you are under 21 and drive with any amount of alcohol in your blood.
questions.explanation: Drivers under 21 cannot have any alcohol in their system. Even a trace of alcohol will result in serious penalties, including a two-year license suspension.

questions.question: Which of these is a safe driving technique?

options.text: Using your high beam lights in the fog.
Staring at the road ahead of your vehicle.

questions.explanation: Check your rearview mirrors every two to five seconds to stay aware of hazards. Staring only ahead is unsafe. In fog, use low beam lights, not high beams.

questions.question: This yellow warning sign means:

options.text: You are approaching a school or school crosswalk.
Slow down, drive with caution, and watch for children.

questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers near schools to slow down, be careful, and watch for children.

questions.question: To turn left from a multilane one-way street onto a one-way street, start your turn from:

options.text: Any lane (as long as it is safe).
The lane closest to the left curb.
The lane in the center of the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: The lane closest to the left curb.
questions.explanation: When turning left from a one-way street to another one-way street, start from the far left lane.

questions.question: On a green arrow, you must:

options.text: Yield to any vehicle, bicycle, or pedestrian in the intersection.
Yield to pedestrians only in the intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yield to any vehicle, bicycle, or pedestrian in the intersection.
questions.explanation: A green arrow means go. Turn in the direction the arrow points after you yield to all vehicles, bicycles, and pedestrians in the intersection.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts drivers that the right lane is ending. Be ready for traffic to merge.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this location. It is unsafe and against the law.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits right turns. You must follow this rule.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign is placed on vehicles that travel slowly.

questions.question: You should drive slower than the posted speed limit for which of these reasons?
questions.explanation: Drive slower than the speed limit when weather or traffic is bad. Always slow down when approaching an intersection, going around curves, going over hills, or driving on narrow, winding roads. Watch for pedestrians, traffic, weather problems, mechanical issues, and road conditions.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Watch for people crossing the road.

questions.explanation: This orange sign warns drivers that roadwork is coming. Stay alert for temporary traffic control devices in the work zone.

questions.question: Any amount of alcohol in your blood can affect your:
questions.explanation: Even a small amount of alcohol can affect your ability to drive safely. Any alcohol can impair your judgment and physical coordination. Driving after drinking any amount of alcohol is illegal.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you the road will turn sharply right and then sharply left.

questions.question: If you feel tired while driving, you should:

options.text: Stop and rest or let someone else drive.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop and rest or let someone else drive.
questions.explanation: To prevent tired driving, take a break every hour during long trips. Share driving with another person so you can both rest.

questions.question: Large vehicles have blind spots that can extend up to 200 feet behind the vehicle.
questions.explanation: Large vehicles have blind spots that extend up to 200 feet behind them. Do not tailgate large vehicles because the driver cannot see you.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must stop for other traffic.
Traffic is merging in. Make space so drivers can merge safely into traffic.
Traffic is merging in. Stay in the right lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is merging in. Make space so drivers can merge safely into traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic is entering from another road. Check your side and rear mirrors, then move to another lane if possible to give merging drivers a clear path.

questions.question: This is the shape and color of a ____ sign.
questions.explanation: Triangular signs pointing downward mean yield. Slow down when you see a yield sign and stop if needed. Stop at a marked stop line if one exists.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn in the direction shown by the arrow. In this case, right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: Like alcohol and drugs, drowsiness can:

options.text: Help you be a better driver.

questions.explanation: Not getting enough sleep causes poor driving. Drowsiness, like drugs and alcohol, slows your reaction time, reduces awareness, and impairs judgment.

questions.question: When you see this yellow sign, you should:

options.text: Stop at the crosswalk until a crossing guard signals you to go.
Be ready to stop if children are in the crosswalk.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready to stop if children are in the crosswalk.
questions.explanation: A five-sided yellow sign means you are near a school. Watch for children and stop if any are in the crosswalk.

questions.question: You see a green light ahead, but traffic is blocking the intersection. What should you do?

options.text: Partially enter the intersection to claim your right-of-way.
Do not enter the intersection until you can drive all the way across.
Enter the intersection and wait for traffic to clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: Do not enter the intersection until you can drive all the way across.
questions.explanation: Even with a green light, do not enter an intersection unless you can cross it completely before the light turns red. Blocking the intersection can result in a ticket.

questions.question: You are driving on a one-way street. You can only turn left onto another one-way street if:

options.text: Traffic on that street moves to the right.
Traffic on that street moves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic on that street moves to the left.
questions.explanation: You can turn left onto a one-way street where traffic moves to the left, unless a sign says otherwise. You cannot turn left onto a one-way street where traffic moves to the right.

questions.question: In a car on a highway, what is illegal?

options.text: Drinking from or having open alcohol containers in the car.
Drinking alcohol if you are not the driver.
Drinking alcohol while driving but not being drunk.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drinking from or having open alcohol containers in the car.
questions.explanation: It is illegal to drive under the influence of alcohol. Drivers and passengers cannot have open alcohol containers in a moving vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about conditions coming up. This sign warns you that you are leaving a separated one-way highway and entering a two-way highway.

questions.question: Your reaction time slows down after:
questions.explanation: Alcohol slows your reflexes and reaction time. It also hurts your vision and focus. More alcohol makes your judgment worse and your driving skills decrease. You will have trouble judging distances, speeds, and how other vehicles are moving.
